rationale: Direct author future delivery with a deadline and no condition.
text: By Monday afternoon, I will put the invoice reconciliation sheet in your inbox.

rationale: Explicit unqualified team commitment to deliver a work item.
text: Our finance team commits to delivering the completed invoice reconciliation sheet tomorrow.

rationale: An aim is an intention, not an assured delivery.
text: I aim to put the invoice reconciliation sheet in your inbox by Monday afternoon.

rationale: Recipient request, not an author delivery assertion.
text: Please put the invoice reconciliation sheet in our inbox by Monday afternoon.

rationale: Unqualified future delivery by the author team; the call marks a deadline.
text: Our support team will hand over the reproduction package before the troubleshooting call.

rationale: Assured future recipient receipt with explicit author ownership.
text: You will receive the reproduction package from me at nine tomorrow.

rationale: A quoted earlier message is reported wording, not a new direct assertion.
text: The customer quoted an earlier message: "Our support team will hand over the reproduction package tomorrow."

rationale: Completed past delivery, not a prospective assertion.
text: Our support team handed over the reproduction package before yesterday's troubleshooting call.

rationale: Explicit author promise of future work-item delivery.
text: I promise to upload the localization glossary for you on Thursday.

rationale: Definite scheduled delivery and explicit author-team origin.

rationale: Future delivery depends on an explicit approval condition.

rationale: Asks the recipient team to deliver; no author-owned delivery assertion.

rationale: Scheduled future-progressive delivery by the author team.
text: We are sending you the office-hours agenda first thing tomorrow.

rationale: Direct unqualified author future sharing with a deadline.

rationale: Historical attribution of a promise rather than a fresh author assertion.

rationale: Explicit negation of future delivery.

rationale: Explicit guarantee of future delivery with author ownership.

rationale: Unqualified author-team future supply of a concrete artifact.

rationale: Delivery timing is framed as an estimate, not an assurance.

rationale: Question requests the recipient team's delivery.

rationale: Passive future delivery explicitly owned by the author team.

rationale: Definite author-owned future handover of a work item.

rationale: Counterfactual delivery, not a firm real-world future assertion.

rationale: Explicit undertaking to deliver a document; no promise about the credit amount.

rationale: Unqualified future recipient receipt explicitly attributed to the author.

rationale: Recipient request rather than an author-owned delivery statement.

rationale: Direct author future delivery of a draft; no claim that its contents are approved.

rationale: Explicit author-team assurance of future document delivery.

rationale: Historical record of a promise rather than a new unqualified assertion.

rationale: Completed delivery rather than a future one.

rationale: Explicit team commitment to future artifact delivery.
